script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling this the one thing Jotham does not copy from Uzziah implies he copies everything else. The passage does not say that.
The coupon joke does not make a clear connection to building and lands as a forced comparison.
Calling the towers lookout spots assigns them a purpose the passage does not give.
Jotham’s victory does not establish that nobody drove him back at any point in the war.

Saying Jotham rests there with his fathers implies they are buried there too. The passage says he rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, but does not say where his fathers were buried.
David is identified as a king without a reference establishing that fact. The cited verse names the City of David but does not identify David as a king.
“Good memory” assumes the baker chose Palms because they remembered its biblical connection. “Wrong grave” also uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
